Description: Unique identifier for each person in the dataset.
Valid values / range: P followed by a four-digit number, e.g. P0001

Description: Age of the respondent in completed years.

Valid values / range: White; Asian or Asian British; Black, Black British, Caribbean or African; Mixed or multiple ethnic groups; Other ethnic group

Description: Region of England in which the respondent lives.
Valid values / range: North East; North West; Yorkshire and The Humber; East Midlands; West Midlands; East of England; London; South East; South West
Employed; Unemployed; Retired; Student; Economically inactive
Very good; Good; Fair; Bad; Very bad; missing values permitted

Description: Number of vaccination doses received by the respondent.
Valid values / range: 0 doses; 1 dose; 2 doses; 3+ doses; missing values permitted

Description: Number of days in the previous 28 days that the respondent was unable to carry out their usual activities.
Number of hours the respondent worked away from home during the previous week.
Valid values / range: 0 or greater; missing values permitted. Primarily applicable to employed respondents.
